sonnet.problem: Card 12 already tells the baker the cart is watched to see if it goes up the road toward Beth-shemesh, and card 13 builds on it. Card 16 then asks where the cows head, and the answer is Beth-shemesh. A story card gave away the answer to a later choice card, and the question re-asks a fact already told.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact.

sonnet.problem: The question says 'see all this', which points back to the offerings on an earlier story card the baker can no longer see. It doesn't say who or what is being seen.
sonnet.rule: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
